filename.description: The story’s web address: pacificroselactation.com/stories/(this). It fills in from the headline. To change it, click the box before the first save. Short and lowercase, words joined with dashes. Changing it after the story is live breaks shared links, so ask Emily first.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: A short headline about the challenge.

fields.name: tag
fields.label: Topic
fields.description: Pick the closest topic. This is what the filter buttons use.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Parent’s name (optional)
fields.description: First name, or first name and initial. Shown next to the city on the story page. Leave blank to show "Parent".

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Card teaser
fields.description: One or two sentences shown on the story card.

fields.name: going
fields.label: What was going on
fields.description: The parent's words. 3 to 5 sentences. Do not include quotation marks.

fields.name: worked
fields.label: What we worked on
fields.description: The parent's words. 3 to 5 sentences.

fields.name: now
fields.label: How it feels now
fields.description: The parent's words. 3 to 5 sentences.

fields.name: serviceLabel
fields.label: Related service
fields.description: Shown in a box at the end of the story with a "Learn more" button. The button goes to the right page automatically.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Keep hidden (draft)
fields.description: Turn this OFF only when the parent has approved the final wording in writing. Hidden stories do not appear on the site.

fields.name: sample
fields.label: This is a sample story
fields.description: Leave ON for placeholder stories. Turn OFF for real stories. Sample stories are labeled and hidden from Google.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: Google title (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use the headline.

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.label: Google description (optional)
fields.description: One sentence for search results.

fields.name: color
fields.label: Card color
fields.description: Background color of this story on the Stories page.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Position on the Stories page
fields.description: 1 = top of the page. Lower numbers appear first.

fields.name: cancelledDates
fields.label: Skip a date
fields.description: Add a date to remove it from the regular schedule, for example a holiday. It disappears from "Save the date" and the "Next Bloom Circle" badge.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-02

fields.name: note
fields.label: Reason (only you see this)
fields.description: For example: Thanksgiving week

fields.name: extraDates
fields.label: Add an extra date
fields.description: A one-off session that is not on the regular schedule. It shows up in "Save the date".

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-10

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note (optional)
fields.description: For example: Guest speaker

fields.name: scheduleLabel
fields.label: When it meets (in words)
fields.description: Shown on the home page, Bloom Circle page and footer. For example: 1st + 3rd Wednesdays. Changing this does not change the actual dates; ask Emily for that.

fields.name: timeLabel
fields.label: Time (in words)
fields.description: Shown next to "When it meets". For example: 10am to 12pm

fields.name: venue
fields.label: Venue name
fields.description: For example: Taborspace. Shown on the home page, Bloom Circle page, contact page and footer.

fields.name: venueNote
fields.label: Venue note
fields.description: Small line above the address in the "Where we meet" box on the Bloom Circle page.

fields.name: mapsUrl
fields.label: Directions link
fields.description: Where the "Get directions" button goes. Paste a Google Maps link.

fields.name: topics
fields.label: Topics
fields.description: The rounded tags under "Past + upcoming topics" on the Bloom Circle page. One topic per line.

fields.name: services
fields.label: Services
fields.description: Your main services. Each one is a card on the home page, an expandable section on the Services page, and a choice in the contact form. They are numbered automatically in this order. Drag to reorder.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Service name
fields.description: Full name, shown on the Services page. For example: Tongue tie assessment + support

fields.name: shortTitle
fields.label: Short name (home page card)
fields.description: A shorter version for the home page card. For example: Tongue tie

fields.name: homeBlurb
fields.label: Home page card text
fields.description: One or two sentences.

fields.name: homeMeta
fields.label: Session length (home page card)
fields.description: For example: 60 to 90 minutes

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle (Services page)
fields.description: Shown under the name on the Services page.

fields.name: color
fields.label: Card color
fields.description: Background of the home page card, and the circle behind the number on the Services page.

fields.name: open
fields.label: Start opened on the Services page
fields.description: Usually only the first service.

fields.name: left
fields.label: Details: left column
fields.description: Shown when the service is opened on the Services page.

fields.name: right
fields.label: Details: right column
fields.description: The checklist on the right when the service is opened. For example: What we cover.

fields.name: cashRate
fields.label: Price (Services page, "Payment + insurance" box)
fields.description: The large price near the bottom of the Services page. For example: $200

fields.name: insurance
fields.label: Insurance accepted (Services page, "Payment + insurance" box)
fields.description: Small tags under the price. One plan per line.

fields.name: pills
fields.label: Quick facts under the Services page title
fields.description: The row of small rounded tags just under the big Services page heading. Keep each one short. Update these if the price or insurance changes.

fields.name: also
fields.label: Other things you help with (Services page)
fields.description: Tags shown after the list of services, next to "Also supporting".

fields.name: items
fields.label: Questions
fields.description: The "Good to know" questions at the bottom of the Services page. Drag to reorder. If you change the price, insurance or session lengths, check the answers here too.

fields.name: linkLabel
fields.label: Link at the end of the answer (optional)
fields.description: The words to click. For example: See Bloom Circle dates

fields.name: linkHref
fields.label: Link goes to (optional)
fields.description: Leave this and the link text empty for no link.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Used as the description of your photo for screen readers.

fields.name: homeCred
fields.label: Credentials (home page)
fields.description: The short line under "Hi, I’m Whitney" on the home page.

fields.name: homeBlurb
fields.label: Intro (home page)
fields.description: The paragraph under your credentials on the home page.

fields.name: homeFacts
fields.label: Facts (home page)
fields.description: The three big numbers under your intro on the home page. Three works best.

fields.name: big
fields.label: Big text
fields.description: For example: 400+

fields.name: small
fields.label: Small text underneath
fields.description: For example: infants treated each year

fields.name: aboutCred
fields.label: Credentials (About page)
fields.description: The full list of credentials at the top of the About page.

fields.name: bio
fields.label: Your story (About page)
fields.description: The paragraphs at the top of the About page. Drag to reorder.

fields.name: facts
fields.label: Facts (About page)
fields.description: The big numbers under your story on the About page.

fields.name: timeline
fields.label: Timeline (About page)
fields.description: The "My path" timeline on the About page, oldest first. Drag to reorder.

fields.name: year
fields.label: Year
fields.description: Or a short label, for example: NHS

fields.name: items
fields.label: Testimonials
fields.description: The "Kind words" quotes on the home page. Only add a testimonial with written permission from the parent.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.description: Do not include quotation marks.

fields.name: attribution
fields.label: Attribution
fields.description: First name only, plus city. For example: Sam, Portland

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: This is a placeholder
fields.description: Turn OFF for a real testimonial.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short. For example: RN · IBCLC

fields.name: line2
fields.label: Second line
fields.description: On phones the two lines stack; on wider screens they sit on one line. Keep both short.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short. For example: 13+ years

fields.name: line2
fields.label: Second line
fields.description: On phones the two lines stack; on wider screens they sit on one line. Keep both short.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short. For example: Insurance

fields.description: On phones the two lines stack; on wider screens they sit on one line. Keep both short.

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Small heading
fields.description: For example: Not sure where to start?

fields.label: Small label
fields.description: A few words in capitals above the text. For example: Feeding hurts

fields.name: line1
fields.label: First line
fields.description: Keep both lines short so the tiles stay even.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Small label
fields.description: A few words in capitals above the text. For example: Feeding hurts

fields.label: First line
fields.description: Keep both lines short so the tiles stay even.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Small label
fields.description: A few words in capitals above the text. For example: Feeding hurts

fields.description: Keep both lines short so the tiles stay even.

fields.label: Small label
fields.description: A few words in capitals above the text. For example: Feeding hurts

fields.name: line1
fields.label: First line
fields.description: Keep both lines short so the tiles stay even.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.description: Shown on the home page, contact page and footer.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.description: Where the "Email Whitney" links go, on the contact page and in the footer.

fields.name: astoriaPhone
fields.label: Astoria front desk phone
fields.description: The button on the "Office visits" card on the Services page.

fields.name: bookingUrl
fields.label: Home visit booking link
fields.description: Where the "Book a home visit" button goes. Paste your booking page link.

fields.name: instagramHandle
fields.label: Instagram name
fields.description: Shown under the home page tiles. For example: @pacificroselactation

fields.name: instagramUrl
fields.label: Instagram link
fields.description: Where the Instagram icon and links go.

fields.name: facebookUrl
fields.label: Facebook link
fields.description: Where the Facebook icon and link in the footer go.

fields.name: portraitPhoto
fields.label: Whitney's photo
fields.description: Shown on the home page and About page. A portrait (taller than wide) works best.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Business name
fields.description: Used in the footer and in the browser tab title.
